LightningComponentBundle.description: Sales / Field Sales - Map view of the territory: Accounts pinned by billing geo, color-coded by open pipeline, with side filters (Owner, RecordType, Open amount range, Stages, Case status, Type, Industry + name search), KPI tiles and CSV export.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default.

property.name: defaultOwnerScope
property.label: Default owner scope
property.description: 'mine' = accounts owned by the running user (with auto-fallback to all when empty). 'all' = every owner.

property.name: defaultRecordType
property.label: Default RecordType (developer name)
property.description: Optional. Pre-selects an Account RecordType filter (developer name). Leave empty to show all types.

property.name: defaultStagesCsv
property.label: Default opportunity stages (CSV)
property.description: Optional. Pre-selects opportunity stages used to compute open-amount KPIs. Empty = all open opportunities.

property.name: filterFieldAApiName
property.label: Filter field A (API name)
property.description: API name of an Account picklist used as a filter and shown in the side list (default: Type). Set to a custom field if useful.

property.name: filterFieldBApiName
property.label: Filter field B (API name)
property.description: API name of an Account picklist used as a filter and shown in the side list (default: Industry). Set to a custom field if useful.

property.name: defaultCenterLatitude
property.label: Default center - latitude
property.description: Initial map center latitude. Defaults to France (46.7). Override for other regions.

property.name: defaultCenterLongitude
property.label: Default center - longitude
property.description: Initial map center longitude. Defaults to France (2.5).

property.name: mapHeight
property.label: Map height (px)
property.description: Fixed height of the map + list area. The list scrolls independently inside this height.

property.name: mapWidthRatio
property.label: Map / list ratio
property.description: Horizontal split ratio between the map (left) and the account list (right). Range 0.4 - 0.85. Default 0.66 = map ~ 2/3, list ~ 1/3.
